text: Figure 7.16: High-level crypto system design The values for attribute CryptoKeySlotDesignDescription.cryptoAlgorith- mId listed in [TPS_MANI_01470] are standardized by AUTOSAR. The list of crypto algorithms contained in [TPS_MANI_01470] represents an open list. This means that it is possible to use a custom value in attribute CryptoKeySlotDe- signDescription.cryptoAlgorithmId, provided that the custom value is guar- anteed to not clash with future extensions of the standard. This protection against a future name clash can be achieved by adding a name frag- ment (e.g. a company name) to the custom value that is highly unlikely to appear in a future extension of the standard.
